releaseNotes:
v6.6.5 — Downloads Section & Playlist Updates

• Dedicated Downloads Section: Instant access to all your downloaded music directly in your Library alongside Liked Songs.
• Downloads Quick Access: Added 1-tap Downloads button right in the Library header.
• Play All & Shuffle Offline: Easily play all downloaded tracks or shuffle offline with complete queue support.
• Equalizer Tuning & Reset Flat: Fixed EQ flat preset and slider scaling, added instant 1-tap 'Reset Flat' button.
• In-App Privacy & Transparency: Clear privacy policy with user acceptance in onboarding and settings.
• Active Device Telemetry: Lightweight, privacy-respecting install counter with full opt-out control.
